tasks.title: Clearer stock numbers in the API
phrasings: The `available`, `copies` and `onLoan` numbers in the book API are confusing side by side. Group them into one object, `stock: { total, onShelf, onLoan }`. In `BookSummary` (`GET /books`), `stock` replaces `available` and `copies`; in `BookDetail` (`GET /books/:id`), it replaces `available` and `onLoan` (`Book.copies` stays, since `POST /books` takes and returns it). Update the types in `src/shared/types.ts`, the repos and the contract tests.

Clean up how the API reports copies. Introduce `stock: { total, onShelf, onLoan }` in `src/shared/types.ts` and use it instead of the loose fields: `BookSummary` (the rows of `GET /books`) drops `available` and `copies` for `stock`, and `BookDetail` (`GET /books/:id`) drops `available` and `onLoan` for `stock`, keeping `Book.copies` because `POST /books` uses it. Update the server's repos and the contract tests.

API consumers keep mixing up `available`, `copies` and `onLoan`. Replace them with a single `stock` object `{ total, onShelf, onLoan }`: in `BookSummary` (from `GET /books`) instead of `available` and `copies`, and in `BookDetail` (from `GET /books/:id`) instead of `available` and `onLoan`. `Book.copies` is unchanged, because `POST /books` takes and returns it. Change the shared types, the repos and the contract tests.

tasks.title: Low-stock badges in the book list
phrasings:
Make the book list more useful at a glance. In `renderBookList` (`src/client/views.ts`), add a badge right after a book's title: `Last copy` when exactly one copy is on the shelf, and `Waitlist` when none is. Also add `renderShelfStats(books: BookSummary[]): string`, returning `

N titles, M of K copies on the shelf

`, where M counts the copies on the shelf now and K all copies. Add unit tests.

Two small improvements to the book list in `src/client/views.ts`. First, in `renderBookList`, put a badge after the title when stock is low: `Last copy` if exactly one copy is on the shelf, `Waitlist` if none is. Second, a summary line under the list: a new `renderShelfStats(books: BookSummary[]): string` that returns `

N titles, M of K copies on the shelf

` (M: copies on the shelf right now; K: all copies). Add unit tests.

People can't tell which books are about to run out. Add low-stock badges to `renderBookList` in `src/client/views.ts`, right after the title: `Waitlist` when no copy is on the shelf and `Last copy` when exactly one is. Add `renderShelfStats(books: BookSummary[]): string` too, which returns `

N titles, M of K copies on the shelf

` with M the copies on the shelf now and K the total copies. Cover both with unit tests.
